descFull: Compress any video to an exact size (Discord 20 MB, WeChat 20 MB, WhatsApp 16 MB) locally with FFmpeg - on Windows as a single .exe with nothing to install, or via npm. HDR tone-mapped, VMAF/SSIM prove the quality, and it runs as an MCP server.
